name: max_replication_slots
description: Sets the maximum number of simultaneously defined replication slots, which reserve WAL segments to prevent premature removal and enable reliable logical or physical standby synchronization.
symptoms: Server fails to start when value is lower than existing slots
Standby servers fall behind or disconnect due to WAL removal
WAL accumulation and disk space exhaustion
Logical replication consumers stop receiving changes
tuning_tips: Set this value to at least the total number of physical and logical standbys plus any planned future slots; increase only as needed since each slot consumes memory and WAL retention overhead.
